title: Workforce capacity policy
description: Thresholds that turn observed work-item load into a workforce availability status and into selection penalties, so team composition prefers actors that are not already saturated.

busy_at_active_items.description: Active (claimed, in-progress) work items at which a resource is reported busy.

saturated_at_active_items.description: Active work items at which a resource is reported saturated and should not take more.

max_load_penalty.description: Ceiling on the combined load penalty so load never outweighs a capability match.
